meta.naming: Token names here are target-neutral. Each target adds its own namespace: web --bh-<name>, Textual $bh-<name>, Click/Python bh.<name>.

color.note: Two layers. Primitives are named warm pigments (mandarin, sky, amaranth, cod ... parchment) and are never used directly. The semantic layer maps them to roles per theme; implementations only ever read the semantic names.

tokens.name: color-black
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Maximum-contrast ink (color-text-bright, light).

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Overlay surface (light) and text on primary/danger fills (light).

tokens.name: color-mandarin
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. The signal orange - brand colour, primary, focus ring, link hover.

tokens.name: color-mandarin-light
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Primary hover (dark theme).

tokens.name: color-mandarin-lighter
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Primary pressed (dark theme).

tokens.name: color-mandarin-dark
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Primary hover (light theme).

tokens.name: color-mandarin-darker
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Primary pressed (light theme).

tokens.name: color-sky
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Success only. Kept blue so success never sits on the red-green axis beside danger.

tokens.name: color-pine
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Secondary accent and links, light theme (5.4-6.1:1 on the light surfaces).

tokens.name: color-pine-light
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Secondary accent and links, dark theme (7.2-8.8:1 on the dark surfaces).

tokens.name: color-pomegranate
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Warning.

tokens.name: color-amaranth
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Tertiary accent - danger.

tokens.name: color-amaranth-light

tokens.name: color-amaranth-lighter
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Danger pressed (dark theme).

tokens.name: color-amaranth-dark
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Danger hover (light theme).

tokens.name: color-amaranth-darker
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Danger pressed (light theme).

tokens.name: color-night
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Recessed wells (dark theme).

tokens.name: color-thunder
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Dark-theme surface.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Light-theme body text.

tokens.name: color-soot

tokens.name: color-mine-shaft
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Raised and overlay surfaces, secondary fill (dark theme).

tokens.name: color-tundora
tokens.usage: Primitive - feeds the semantic layer only; no component may reference it directly. Default border (dark theme), terminal frame.

tokens.name: color-boulder

tokens.name: color-swiss-coffee

tokens.name: color-linen

tokens.name: color-bone

tokens.name: color-pearl

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page / app ground. Everything sits on it; the shell paints it.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Sections, sidebars, status bar, table header, pixel panel.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, selects, textareas, table body, popovers - one step up from surface.

tokens.name: color-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, command palette, context menu - the topmost plane.

tokens.name: color-surface-recessed
tokens.usage: Wells below the ground: activity bar, terminal bar, off pixels, ghost segments.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and control labels on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-overlay. Passes 4.5:1 on all four in both themes.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help text, meta, panel and section labels, status bar. Light: 5.7-6.4:1 on every surface (passes). Dark: 2.2-2.7:1 on every surface - FAILS AA as shipped; use color-text for anything a person must read in dark.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders and terminal hint labels. Same value and same dark-theme failure as color-text-muted.

tokens.name: color-text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an inverted ground (the opposite theme's surfaces).

tokens.name: color-text-bright
tokens.usage: Maximum-contrast emphasis - terminal {bright} role, headings that must shout.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: The one signal: primary action fill, active indicators, progress fill, slider thumb, LEDs and segment readouts. As text it passes only in dark (5.7-6.9:1); in light it is 2.2-2.5:1 - a fill and mark colour, never body text.

tokens.name: color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-primary-active
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: color-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill. Dark: 6.9:1 (passes). Light: white on mandarin is 2.84:1 - FAILS AA as shipped (3.5:1 on the hover fill).

tokens.name: color-primary-glow
tokens.usage: Halo behind lit primary marks: LED glow, segment glow, card corner accents on hover. Never a fill for text.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet control fill: secondary button, avatar, hover wash for ghost buttons, nav and tree rows, progress track, skeleton.

tokens.name: color-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-secondary-active
tokens.usage: Secondary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: color-secondary-text
tokens.usage: Label on a secondary fill (13.7:1 light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The brand orange for decorative accents (same value as color-primary).

tokens.name: color-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary accent - pine: deep in light, sage in dark. Links and secondary highlights. Never a status colour; success stays sky.

tokens.name: color-accent-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary accent - the pink-red. Same value as danger.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success / healthy / landed. Blue, not green, so it never relies on a red-green split, and kept apart from the pine accent. As text: dark 8.0:1 (passes); light 2.1:1 (fails) - on light grounds use it for marks (LED, bar, badge fill) and let the label be color-text.

tokens.name: color-success-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind success content; LED glow.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning. As text: dark 5.3:1; light 3.1:1 (large text only). Sits close to danger in lightness (1.14:1) - always pair with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: color-warning-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind warning content.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, invalid fields, required asterisk. As text: dark 4.7:1; light 3.6:1 (large text only).

tokens.name: color-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Danger fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-danger-active
tokens.usage: Danger fill while pressed.

tokens.name: color-danger-text
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill. Dark 4.7:1 (passes); light 4.2:1 (fails AA for 16px labels by a hair).

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card outlines, inputs, table rules, panel edges. 1.4:1 light / 1.3:1 dark - decorative strength; an input's edge does not meet the 3:1 non-text floor as shipped.

tokens.name: color-border-muted
tokens.usage: Faint separators: section-header rule, muted dividers.

tokens.name: color-border-bright
tokens.usage: Emphasised edge where a boundary must be seen.

tokens.name: color-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Dark 6.5-6.9:1 (passes); light 2.2-2.4:1 (below the 3:1 floor as shipped).

tokens.name: color-link
tokens.usage: Default link text, in the pine accent. Light 5.8:1 on bg (5.4-6.1:1 across surfaces); dark 8.8:1 on bg (7.2-8.8:1). Passes AA in both themes.

tokens.name: color-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-link-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet link in running text and footers (6.1:1 light, 11.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-link-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Quiet link under the pointer - it takes the pine accent.

groups.note: The system face. Three roles, one family.

styles.sample: All services operational. Disk usage at 82%.

styles.name: small

styles.name: badge

groups.name: Instrument

styles.name: section-label

groups.name: Readout
groups.note: 14-segment LED readouts. Uppercase only; digits, A-Z and + - . : render.

styles.name: segment-xl
styles.usage: Segment display size xl - hero readouts.

spacing.note: A 4px-based rem scale (1rem = 16px) with half steps below 4. Layout gaps use the named subset: none 0 · xs 1 · sm 2 · md 4 · lg 6 · xl 8 · 2xl 12.

tokens.name: spacing-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: spacing-0-5
tokens.usage: 2px - small badge and chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: 4px - gap xs; medium badge/chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-1-5
tokens.usage: 6px - small button vertical padding, form-field gap, tooltip vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: 8px - gap sm; control inner gap (icon to label); medium button vertical padding; card padding sm.

tokens.name: spacing-2-5
tokens.usage: 10px - large button vertical padding; medium badge/chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: 12px - small button horizontal padding; panel-header and status-bar side padding.

tokens.name: spacing-3-5
tokens.usage: 14px.

tokens.name: spacing-4

tokens.name: spacing-5
tokens.usage: 20px.

tokens.name: spacing-6

tokens.name: spacing-7

tokens.name: spacing-11

tokens.name: spacing-12

tokens.name: spacing-24

radius.note: Machined, not soft: 6px is the default corner; pills only for badges, chips, LEDs and switches.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: No rounding - flush edges and panels that sit edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 2px - checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: 6px - the default: buttons, inputs, selects, textareas.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: 8px - cards, tables, pixel panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: 12px.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: 16px.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and discs: badges, chips, LEDs, switch, avatar.

shadow.note: Two kinds of depth. Elevation (sm-xl) lifts things off the ground. Relief (inset, raised, emboss) makes the surface itself feel machined - pressed wells and embossed rules. Dark theme uses heavier elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Flat.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Primitive - smallest lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Primitive - card default (card variant default).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Primitive - popovers and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Primitive - modal and command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic - resting lift for a surface (sm in light, md in dark).

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Semantic - pressed wells: switch track, recessed displays.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Semantic - a physical key sitting proud: switch thumb, keycaps.

tokens.name: shadow-emboss
tokens.usage: Semantic - the machined groove of a divider.

duration.note: The continuous clock. Transitions are a duration plus ease-default. See the Motion section for the display clock and sequences.

tokens.name: duration-frame
tokens.usage: One display frame (1/12 s at fps-display). The stagger unit between items in a sequence.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, press, colour changes - most shipped transitions.

tokens.name: duration-pixel
tokens.usage: A pixel or LED turning on or off (pixel display).

tokens.name: duration-normal
tokens.usage: State and size changes: sidebar and shell width, progress fill, card corner glow.

tokens.name: duration-sweep
tokens.usage: A pixel-matrix redraw sweeping left to right (pixel panel sweep transition).

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: One beat of a motion sequence: a power-on step, a readout count. No shipped component uses it.

frameRate.note: The display clock. Readouts, pixel matrices, meters and terminal text update in whole frames at this rate and never tween between values.

tokens.name: fps-display
tokens.usage: Display updates in every medium: pixel panels (the source default), segment counts, type-on, cell-medium spinners and meters.

loop.note: Periods of the looping indicators. Only one loop may run in a view besides the cursor.

tokens.name: loop-cursor
tokens.usage: Terminal cursor blink, ease-in-out.

tokens.name: loop-spinner
tokens.usage: One spinner turn, ease-linear.

tokens.name: loop-skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton opacity pulse, ease-in-out.

tokens.name: loop-progress
tokens.usage: Indeterminate progress sweep, ease-in-out.

tokens.name: loop-led
tokens.usage: LED pulse (live, or waiting on you), ease-in-out.

tokens.name: ease-default
tokens.usage: Standard deceleration - every transition unless noted.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Accelerating - things leaving.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Decelerating - things arriving.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Symmetric (same curve as default). Breathing loops: LED, skeleton, indeterminate progress.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Constant rate - spinner rotation and the display clock.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle backdrop blur.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Pronounced backdrop blur behind overlays.
